notes: s014 is the preposition אֵת with (H854), not the object marker, and takes the written with (rule 16's closing caution).
s010 אֹת is the object marker and is unrepresented, the ASV writing the object as the bare pronoun him, which belongs to its suffix (rules 16, 18).
אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּית is split as in 31.14 and 31.18: nether parts to the adjective, of the earth to the noun.
